description:
Add a budget (e.g. a month) to an existing Time Tracker project (id from list_time_tracker_projects). Managers only. currency is a 3-letter code; periodStart is YYYY-MM-DD. The budget is seeded with a default service so time can be logged right away. A project of another organization or property returns not_found. Available only on accounts with Time Tracker enabled.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// add a monthly budget to a project.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","project":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","name":"December 2026","currency":"EUR","periodStart":"2026-12-01"}
```
name: create_time_tracker_budget

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Create time tracker budget
